$comment: One owner per defect class: detector → owner (the lens or agent whose finding it is) → fixer → fallback when the owner's pack is not installed → home pack. Today's agent names are used; `target` names the Phase-6 consolidated role (proposal §3.5) so the merge has a map. An agent's Boundary section should agree with this file: if two agents both claim a class here, one of them is wrong. JSON for the same reason as thresholds.json (stdlib consumers). Edit a row, never fork a class into two rows.

n-plus-one.fallback: the database detector's own report when performance is not installed
n-plus-one.note: query-optimizer's knowledge is fix guidance for this class, not a second detector

wcag.detector: frontend/skills/a11y-code-scan (source) · frontend/skills/a11y-scan (axe at route-state; THR-A11Y.axe_gate, gate G9) · mobile/skills/mobile-a11y-scan (native)
wcag.owner: ui-ux/agents/ux-reviewer (the one WCAG judge, web and native)
wcag.fixer: /frontend-fix (frontend) · /mobile-fix (mobile); contrast, focus ring and tap target through ui-design-sweep verbs 12, 13 and 16 (/polish, /enhance-ui); the implementer applies
wcag.fallback: frontend/agents/accessibility-auditor when ui-ux is not installed; native screens: the verifier judges mobile-a11y-scan's rows
wcag.note: one class, three detectors: mobile-a11y is the native half of this row, not a second owner

engine-tuning.fixer: operator, behind an ADR for durability settings

acceptance-verdict.fixer: implementer (SPEC_CONFLICT when the contract is wrong)

ui-states.detector: ui-ux/skills/ui-state-scan · ui-ux/skills/state-matrix (state-matrix-lint.py, gate G12 state-matrix; vocabulary THR-UI-STATES)
ui-states.fixer: /frontend-fix · /mobile-fix (the missing branch, failing first); the visual treatment through ui-design-sweep verbs 9–11 (/polish, /enhance-ui)
ui-states.fallback: UNREVIEWED(states) — ux-reviewer not installed (ui-ux pack); the lint still runs when the skill is installed
ui-states.note: the matrix is written at P3 by ui-ux/agents/ux-designer (design.md UI slice by the architect without it)

client-data.fixer: /frontend-fix; a server-side cause → /db-fix or /perf-fix; a cross-user cache leak → /security-fix
client-data.fallback: client-data-scan's own report, verified by the verifier
client-data.note: owns optimistic rollback (CD-05) and UI request races across renders (§3); code-quality correctness-smell-scan §3 keeps the single-effect case

routing.fixer: /frontend-fix (a path, param, redirect target or public status code is a stop-and-ask change)
routing.fallback: routing-scan's own report, verified by the verifier
routing.note: navigation-speed keeps hard reloads and scroll restoration; a11y-code-scan keeps route-change focus

i18n-completeness.fixer: /frontend-fix (non-source locales are the translators' call — stop and ask)
i18n-completeness.fallback: i18n-scan's own report, verified by the verifier
i18n-completeness.note: /i18n-audit is /frontend-audit --classes=i18n; correctness-smell-scan §6 keeps clock and zone arithmetic, i18n-scan §4 the presentation formatting

seo.fixer: /frontend-fix (SEO row); a canonical or public status change is stop-and-ask
seo.fallback: seo-audit's own report, verified by the verifier

design-tokens.fixer: by remedy: ui-design-sweep verbs 1–2 (/polish, /enhance-ui) · /align once the token exists · /unify-surfaces for a wrapper
design-tokens.fallback: design-token-audit's own report; ui-reviewer detects and routes

chart-encoding.fixer: the implementer at the chart; a data ramp as tokens → ui-ux/agents/design-system-architect

mobile-lifecycle.note: durability of queued writes is offline-sync's; a purpose string that changes the store answer is store-compliance's

mobile-perf.detector: mobile/skills/mobile-perf-scan (existence) · mobile/skills/device-harness (cost on a named device)
mobile-perf.owner: mobile/agents/device-performance-auditor (judge; runs mobile-perf-scan and device-harness itself, measures and ranks)
mobile-perf.fixer: /mobile-fix; the cost proof is re-measured by device-performance-auditor
mobile-perf.fallback: the verifier judges mobile-perf-scan's rows; cost: not measured

mobile-a11y.fallback: repo-baseline/.claude/agents/verifier when ui-ux is not installed
mobile-a11y.note: the native half of wcag (same owner); platform-conventions-audit keeps platform conventions only

offline-sync.fallback: offline-sync-scan's own report, durability capped at unproven

store-compliance.fixer: /mobile-fix (config and code); wording, metadata and review notes stay with the human

app-size.owner: mobile/agents/device-performance-auditor (cold start as the measured cost)
app-size.note: store size limits are store-compliance-scan's table, cited not restated

native-bridge.owner: repo-baseline/.claude/agents/verifier (judges /mobile-audit's Native bridge row); whether a bridge should exist → mobile/agents/mobile-architect

mobile-security.fixer: /security-fix (mobile row); a shipped server secret is rotated first
mobile-security.note: /mobile-audit's Device security row consumes it when the security pack is installed
